entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing User, Session, and Agent states via temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted open-source SDK, a standalone server, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and tiered loading. It achieves significant token reduction and task-completion gains by providing observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform enables persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that supports unified ingestion and multimodal data. It provides Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients alongside a local UI for managing cross-session agent memory.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain generates cited prose answers and performs explicit gap analysis to identify missing information. It constructs knowledge graphs using typed edges without LLM calls and ensures data isolation through scoped institutional memory.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official memory provider featuring sub-300ms recall and a custom vector graph engine that supports byte-level deduplication for prompt-cache discounts. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance while connecting to external platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows compatible with over 25 LLM providers. It offers SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go, with deployment options ranging from local Docker containers to managed cloud environments.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library serves as the foundation for stateful agents, providing a FastAPI-based core service for session and peer management. It supports managed, local, and self-hosted deployments and is the upstream project for the Hermes-specific self-hosted wrapper.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory as a git repository, utilizing a five-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based for sub-100ms performance. It features an interactive TUI and supports version control operations like branching and merging over a markdown context tree.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system designed for sub-millisecond performance using a single SQLite database for local storage. It integrates with Hermes Agents via MCP, a Python SDK, or OpenWebUI and requires only Python 3.10 or higher.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure the agent prioritizes injected context during the recall process.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive self-improving harness produces filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and playbooks to assist agents with complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to validate the effectiveness of context changes.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from their history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from 22 supported coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over gigabytes of historical data. It allows agents to search months of past sessions while ensuring safety by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted backend for cross-session memory persistence using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference server to enable private memory for Hermes Agent.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signetai maintains a living semantic ontology through a background process called dreaming to provide portable state across multiple agent clients. It supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub to create a local-first identity and memory layer.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur implements a shared memory layer that stores data as human-readable YAML files on a local disk. It utilizes a hybrid search approach combining BM25 and local embeddings to facilitate retrieval for multi-agent systems.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP and plugins, using hybrid retrieval methods including BM25 and vector search to manage agent memory.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference while preserving accuracy.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It features a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every result and includes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps. It supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments and tracks contradictions and recency ranking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing long-term memory as inspectable Markdown files. It runs locally without a daemon or telemetry, utilizing DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for cross-project memory.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets. It manages state and retrieval using a stack of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally using SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server designed for major coding agent clients, utilizing GGUF models via node-llama-cpp.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It employs a local-first architecture using SQLite and FTS5 to manage memory and context via the Model Context Protocol.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider offers reflective memory for agents using a combination of BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for diverse sources like codebases and multimedia with OCR support, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search integration.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a built-in 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25-first retrieval and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed context layer that provides first-class support for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw agents. It uses a deterministic kernel for hash-checked setups and maintains reviewable decision logs within a Git repository.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin addresses persistent recall issues by supporting real, immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization. It provides high transparency through a trace.jsonl audit log that records every memory and prefetch operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle payments across 29 chains and 10 families, including EVM and Solana, with 0% transaction fees. It allows Hermes agents to settle payments directly to wallets using USDC and other stablecoins.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations to improve agent capability routing. It offers tools for artifact search and graph neighbor traversal, utilizing feedback loops to refine local routing hints.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin features pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots for state persistence. It relies on a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports advanced retrieval features like configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory provider that secures data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and offers flexible execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon. It supports hybrid retrieval methods including HNSW ANN, sparse search, and FM-index recall with MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid BM25, vector, and graph search approach. It also implements automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies data rot and contradictions within agent memory using a git-backed directory for versioned markdown storage. It utilizes specialized curators to propose evidence-cited diffs and offers five slash commands for the capture, recall, and manual review of memory updates.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development methodology for autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for macOS and Windows that generates prototypes, decks, and documents using real CSS and components. It supports coding-agent CLI workflows including Hermes Agent and integrates with DeepSeek Harness and Claude Code.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms for comprehensive security operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts natural language, Mermaid, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments. It enforces architecture contracts through YAML/JSON rules and a Diagram-as-Test approach.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this tool provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer with vendored protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using 72 structural and linguistic categories. It supports rewrite and edit-in-place modes for agents such as Claude Code and Hermes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that natively integrates with Hermes and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within the project's documentation directory for persistent agent context.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 skills for professional and life tasks distributed as plain markdown files. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables Hermes Agent and other tools to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports multiple environments including Cursor and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via dedicated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents using Lite and Full modes. It ensures quality through a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models for project handoffs.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill allows agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits from those files back into the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Built in TypeScript for the Bun runtime, this harness enables supervised team coordination and role-based work via SLP v2. It manages the full lifecycle of work states from open to done using structured command operations without requiring background services.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin implements cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These interoperable skills follow the agentskills.io specification to enable interactions with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. The package includes specialized capabilities for integrating with CRE and ACE services within the Oracle network.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides and skills in the SKILL.md format specifically for Portuguese-speaking users. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard to ensure compatibility with the broader Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide specialized prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX 3 image and video generation. The project includes a router to manage multi-step video workflows and supports both Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files by processing repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It links instructions directly to source lines or URLs and includes a full lifecycle suite for creating, testing, and exporting skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client and CLI, alongside commerce capabilities powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This local-first workflow language uses a single Rust binary and four verbs to execute tasks across any model. It audits workflows for costs and permissions before execution and generates hash-chained receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification for one-click installations. It operates 24/7 on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By reducing token usage and offering graceful degradation, it ensures efficient skill selection even when dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections for agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking. It stores all data in a local SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram, reducing token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It employs a risk-tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python-based goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop issues during debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, covering real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to agent workflows to maintain memory between conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for developing new skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demos using vhs or Playwright to generate optimized GIFs under 8 MB. It streamlines documentation by embedding these visual recordings directly into a project's README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through frontmatter validation. It actively monitors official specifications to detect and report drift, ensuring skills remain compatible with current standards.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework enables agents to self-improve by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It secures the evolution process by gating updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators within a local Python environment.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It maintains a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It facilitates tool discovery and provides direct installation commands for compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides specialized skills for managing environment-specific path syntax and Python interpreter selection on Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. It ensures deterministic file routing and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent environment.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This utility certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill actually works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables agents to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes a complete toolkit for managing bounty boards, buying context, and settling payments upon human approval.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and produces structured briefings containing core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection of skills provides local processing for transcribing Douyin videos and performing macOS-based OCR on invoices and contracts. It also includes a specialized writing engine designed to adjust the tone and style of AI-generated text.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, Cursor, and other agent environments.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from providers like OpenAI and DeepSeek. It serves as a reliable source for developers who need current development tools packaged for the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI, allowing for mobile agent interaction.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. It supports over 70 tools and persistent memory, allowing the agent to interface with both external providers and local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on cloud-native state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on security by sandboxing the agent with hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora acts as a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides management features such as per-agent metrics, LLM budget caps, and cost monitoring accessible via REST API, CLI, or MCP.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports hierarchy-aware communication for inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for autonomous execution, specifically supporting recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It utilizes a researcher team to conduct bullish and bearish debates, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents for final approvals.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces. It supports multi-agent workflows and can be installed locally via Node.js or deployed using Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, through TUI and web dashboards. It ensures persistent sessions via tmux integration and provides sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine manages Hermes agents and specialist teams using the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is the first MCP engine on the Solana blockchain and features HTTP signal detection to handle payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework builds autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and orchestration.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a centralized Kanban board and review queue. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents focused on research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via Hermes Kanban.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time dashboard and scoreboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool maintains a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that synchronizes automatically as files change to reduce token usage and tool calls. It provides structural extraction for TypeScript, JavaScript, ArkTS, and Python, integrating directly with agents like Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility designed to track token consumption across multiple AI coding agents and IDEs, including Hermes and Gemini. It features a 3D visualization dashboard and allows users to submit usage data to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents such as Hermes, Cursor, and Codex. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions and automatically redacts common authentication headers during the recording process.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits for over 35 AI coding tools by reading agent states directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical usage breakdowns categorized by tool, model, and specific project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates with agents including Hermes, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project provides an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. The tool modifies visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring OAuth or external processes. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and enables commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, supporting providers like Anthropic and OpenAI. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function for recent agent-initiated changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for frameworks such as CrewAI and LangGraph, alongside chat bots for Telegram and Slack. It includes a specific plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and research, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing users to define local configurations, skills, and memories. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents to maintain project-specific custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that supports 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that performs deterministic, local analysis of agent configurations and tool descriptions without requiring network access. It identifies ambiguous descriptions or conflicting directives and supports CI integration through GitHub Actions and SARIF reporting.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry for monitoring multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It detects performance drift using config-aware baselines and offers both passive analysis and active probing modes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed to help users generate revenue, this local-first skill utilizes dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime. It ensures security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations performed by the agent.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This plugin adds offline voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, supporting 35 languages and featuring adaptive turn-taking with barge-in support. It operates entirely locally, requiring no API keys or accounts for its wake-word and personal assistant functions.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin provides tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories using multi-dimensional storage and semantic search. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to manage potential MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with Tauri 2, provides a unified desktop interface for controlling Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It is compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, serving as an all-in-one desktop controller for multiple agent engines.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates dozens of external agents, including Hermes Agent, into a single interface. It features 21 built-in professional assistants and offers remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this project provides a web and mobile-friendly interface for interacting with Hermes Agent. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It offers a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one location.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard enables unified configuration for Hermes Agent across 10 messaging platforms, including Telegram and Discord. It features a visual workflow canvas with approval gates, local SQLite session storage, and detailed usage analytics for token consumption.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a memory browser, skills manager, and a full workspace file browser equipped with a Monaco editor and PTY terminal.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop or self-hosted environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and provides native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for managing real session data. It includes native views for Kanban boards and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for direct shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports MCP tools, memory management, and specialized rendering for LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime directly to the active browser context. It features site-aware drafting in 31 writing environments and live browser control with explicit approval gates for all actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone application that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from their mobile device by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It enables real-time chat, task management, and server file system browsing without subscriptions or third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, as well as a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based monitor features an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and scheduled cron jobs. It includes a specialized tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes and git projects.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard that provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: This native macOS session browser functions as a local cockpit that attributes live quota burn to individual sessions for Codex and Claude. It supports searchable transcripts and image browsing for over 14 agent formats without uploading telemetry or session history.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based mission control. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a 10-page mobile-first UI with terminal chat and file attachment support. It uses dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to manage background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that runs without admin rights or system-wide dependencies to provide a Tkinter GUI for local models. It features 100 tools covering music, TTS, and ComfyUI, supported by granular permission controls and session management.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface enables real-time log streaming and chat for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes an integrated file browser, a task tracking dashboard, and management tools for skills and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard provides real-time monitoring of session activity and cost tracking for Hermes deployments. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for interactive agent control. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
